statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); branch=$(cd "$current_dir" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "no-git"); printf "\033[1;34m%s\033[0m | \033[1;32m%s\033[0m | \033[1;33m%s\033[0m" "$model" "$(basename "$current_dir")" "$branch"

hooks.command: afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff & osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code is requesting permission" with title "Claude Code" subtitle "Awaiting confirmation"'
afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Hero.aiff & osascript -e 'display notification "Task completed" with title "Claude Code" subtitle "Process finished"'
